solution: Using $\cos36^{\circ}=1-2\sin^218^{\circ}$ together with $\cos36^{\circ}=\tfrac{\sqrt{5}+1}{4}$ gives $2\sin^218^{\circ}=1-\tfrac{\sqrt{5}+1}{4}=\tfrac{3-\sqrt{5}}{4}$, so $\sin^218^{\circ}=\tfrac{3-\sqrt{5}}{8}=\tfrac{(\sqrt{5}-1)^2}{16}$ and $\sin18^{\circ}=\tfrac{\sqrt{5}-1}{4}$.
